outcome: Developmentally high risk (DHR) at age 4-6 years
Numeracy below national minimum standard at age 7-9 years
Reading results below national minimum standard at age 7-9 years
cohort: Singleton children born at term in New South Wales, Australia, from 2001 to 2014, with N=276,454 for developmental outcome and N=644,291 for school performance.
finding: Infection-related hospitalisation was modestly associated with an increased likelihood of adverse child development and poorer school performance, though this association may be explained by shared familial factors.
